name: AntiDopingWhereaboutsTracker
tagline: Quarterly whereabouts filings, a rolling 12-month failure counter and TUE expiry in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete anti-doping compliance desk for federations, national programmes and professional teams: see who has filed whereabouts before the quarterly deadline, track filing failures and missed tests through notification, athlete response and administrative review with the 12-month count on every card, renew TUEs before they expire, keep anti-doping education current and review testing history. Compliance aid only – not legal advice and not a medical device.
features: Rolling 12-month whereabouts failure counter with drop-off dates
Configurable violation threshold, failure window, filing lead days and response window
Quarter matrix with Complete / Late / Draft / Missing and deadline countdown
Failure workflow board with allowed steps, blocked reasons and threshold acknowledgement
TUE expiry countdown and renewal start (no medical details stored)
Bulk moves, CSV export, delete with undo
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (data-set control + Power Pages field control from one src/app)
